name: acm
comment: Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management, from github.com/stolostron/must-gather
plus its backplane-must-gather submodule (the mce/ scripts).
Hand written, not generated by tools/sync_catalog.py: that tool parses
all_ns_resources appends and exits when they are absent, and ACM's gather
has no such arrays. Nine plugins with hand-written descriptions is less
code than a second parser wearing the first one's name.
Two things differ from openshift/must-gather and are the reason the
profile below exists: there is no common.sh, so --since and --reduce-logs
reach nothing; and the sub-scripts read IS_HUB / IS_ENGINE / IS_OBS_HUB,
which only the gather entrypoint sets, so the profile has to set them too.

setup: if check_if_engine; then IS_ENGINE=true; if check_if_hub; then IS_HUB=true; if check_if_obs_hub; then IS_OBS_HUB=true; fi; fi; fi
profile.noop_pattern: not detected|not installed|[Ss]kipping|[Ss]kip collecting|not found|No resources found|is not a hub cluster|is not an engine cluster|is not a spoke cluster|was not provided

hub_logs.description: MultiClusterHub namespace, CSVs, deployments and their versions, plus the open-cluster-management hub and backup namespaces, proxies, service accounts and roles.

governance_logs.description: Governance (GRC): policies, policysets, policyautomations, placementbindings and policyreports.

application_lifecycle_logs.description: Application lifecycle: applications, channels, deployables, helmreleases, placements and subscriptions, plus the Argo CD / OpenShift GitOps resources and clusterpermissions.

observability_logs.description: MultiClusterObservability, observabilityaddons, the observability namespace, observatoria, the metrics allowlist and MCOA prometheusagents and scrapeconfigs. No-ops unless observability is enabled.

dr_logs.description: Regional disaster recovery: mirrorpeers, drpolicies, DRClusters, drplacementcontrols and channels. No-ops unless a DRCluster exists.

mce_logs.description: MultiCluster Engine (backplane): the MCE resource, its operator and target namespaces, and the cluster lifecycle components. No-ops unless an MCE is installed.

spoke_logs.description: Managed-cluster side: klusterlet and agent addons, policies, configurationpolicies, Gatekeeper, VolSync and submariner. No-ops unless the klusterlet CRD is present.

mce_spoke_logs.description: The MCE half of a managed cluster's collection. Upstream's gather reaches it through gather_spoke_logs rather than directly; select it to run that part alone.

hostedcluster.description: A hosted (HyperShift) cluster's own must-gather, collected with the hypershift CLI into hypershift-dump/. Collects nothing unless you name a cluster.

name.help: Hosted cluster to dump. Without it this plugin no-ops, which is also upstream's behaviour.

namespace.help: Namespace the hosted cluster is in (default clusters).

all_logs.description: The whole hub fan-out in one script: hub, observability, application lifecycle, DR and governance together. Selecting it as well as any of those collects them twice.
